name: Maadi Law, LLC
verdict: The biggest movement this period is a 99% spike in Instagram engagement week-over-week, likely driven by increased Meta creative exposure, while Google Ads spend dropped sharply by 47.33% over the same 7-day window, which pulled overall spend down 35.39% and cost-per-lead down with it to $147.73 across 29 leads. Despite 124 opportunities created in GHL over 28 days, 0 have been marked won, making pipeline conversion the key area to watch for Maadi Law.

performance.verdict: Pipeline intact but 0 won cases and 5 overdue SOW milestones are the real risk.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since July 31–Aug 1: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — none show a completed event.
CPL is $147.73 over 28 days on only 29 leads; last 3 days (Sep 24–26) produced 2 leads on $351 spend vs 4 leads on $459 in the prior 3 days (Sep 21–23) — efficiency softening.
Google spend dropped 47.33% week-over-week and produced only 5 conversions over 28 days at $2,886.65 spend — $577/conversion, well above CPL baseline; pixel/conversion tracking likely broken.
GHL shows 124 opportunities created and 0 won over 28 days, with 0 appointments booked — intake is not converting; this is a pipeline/CRM process leak, not an ads problem.
GBP actions fell 20.51% week-over-week and posted 0 actions on Sep 25–26, while GA4 sessions rose 13.84% — organic visibility declining while site traffic holds, suggesting GBP neglect.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair Google Ads conversion tracking; 5 conversions on $2,887 spend signals pixel failure, not campaign failure.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads recorded only 5 conversions against $2,886.65 in 28-day spend — a $577 cost-per-conversion that almost certainly reflects a broken pixel, not true performance. The tracking milestone (Conversion Actions + Google Tag/GTM install, linked to SOW Month 1) is also overdue. Web and Ops to verify the conversion tag fires on form submit and call events; test end-to-end by Oct 1. Success = at least 1 verified conversion event in Google Ads within 48 hours of fix.

suggestions.text: Escalate 0-appointments, 0-won-cases GHL intake leak; 124 opportunities created with 0 booked calls is a process failure, not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 124 opportunities created over 28 days with 0 appointments and 0 won cases — leads are entering the pipeline but no contact or booking is happening. Nacer to audit the routing rules, auto-reply triggers, and calendar booking setup against the SOW speed-to-lead requirements (first contact under 5 min, after-hours auto-reply). Check whether the calendar/booking link is live and functional. Success = at least 5 confirmed appointments booked within 7 days of fix, by Oct 4.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL: last 3-day window shows softening efficiency; re-check Oct 1 before any budget move.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta delivered 29 leads at $147.73 CPL over 28 days, but the last 3 days (Sep 24–26) produced only 2 leads on ~$351 spend versus 4 leads on ~$459 in the prior 3-day window — a worsening efficiency signal. No budget action is warranted until tracking is confirmed healthy (per S1) and the intake fix (per S2) is in place. Re-check on Oct 1; if CPL exceeds $180 on confirmed leads, escalate to a creative refresh.
